p0_findings.finding: The runner does not require assert.report to exist and be a regular non-symlink file. grep returns rc=2 for a missing report, and the leading Bash ! turns that into success, identical to rc=1 no matches.
p0_findings.impact: The runner can publish DIRECTED_FUNCTIONAL_COMPLETENESS without any assertion-report artifact, despite the contract requiring SVA and assertion coverage enabled.
p0_findings.required_fix: Require sim.log and assert.report to be regular non-symlink files before scanning. Run grep with explicit rc handling so only rc=1 is accepted; rc=0 indicates a failure match and rc>=2 is a runner failure. Empty existing assert.report may be accepted for a passing assert-only TB. Re-review the new runner SHA.

p1_findings.finding: The compile filter recognizes VCS's common Warning-[...] format but a synthetic `Warning:` line is not matched.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Expand the filter to line-start/plain Warning forms and distinguish grep I/O errors from no matches.

p1_findings.finding: The attempt seal commits its two evidence files but does not enforce an exact recursive member set; identity.sha256 contains only runner and contract, while VCS/RTL/TB/filelist/review/docs exist only in the work receipt.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Use an exact attempt member-set check and include the full frozen input identity set in the durable attempt receipt.

p1_findings.finding: m514_complete is set before mv -T work canonical. A rename failure suppresses cleanup/quarantine even though no canonical was published and the attempt is consumed.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Set complete only after the atomic rename succeeds.

p1_findings.finding: The generated receipt omits the contract claim-boundary key formality=false.
p1_findings.recommended_fix: Generate and statically require the exact same negative claim-boundary key set as the contract.

passed_checks.foreign_dormant_simv_policy: PASS: current-user simv always blocked; foreign only S/I, <=0.5 percent CPU, <=256 MiB RSS allowed.

decision.reason: P0 count is nonzero. Missing assertion evidence is fail-open. Supersede and re-review after repair; do not wait for M496 and then run this SHA.
